text:
sre-bot: :warning: SLO ALERT - hosted-api 5xx > 1% (10m window). Route affected: /v1/generate. Region: us-west-2. Incident ref: INC-20260405-09

nina: getting a spike of 502/504s, customers pinging support. Top report: timeouts when sending long prompts (>5k tokens). Anyone oncall can pull traces?

carlos: grabbing traces now. Preliminary: a gap between edge-gateway span and inference runtime spans. Lots of 'connection reset by peer' and 'upstream closed' in gateway logs.

meera: no deploys in last 2 hours. Autoscaler shows scale events that failed due to insufficient GPU quotas in the region around 02:12 PDT. That caused heavy queueing at the edge.

devon: support-bot just posted 3 customer threads with repro steps: they POST big prompt to /v1/generate, SDK retries 2-3x then surfaces 504 to end-user. Some customers reported subsequent billing errors on retries. I've linked the threads.

support-bot: customer A repro: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \ 
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: abc-123' \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-4xlarge","prompt":"<6k tokens>"}'
```
Response: `504 Gateway Timeout` after ~28s. Retry yields `502` then `200` (duplicate charge?).

nina: logs snippet from datadog: 
```
service:gateway AND env:prod AND route:/v1/generate | top(20) by host
```
hosts with highest 502: gw-11, gw-15. runtime hosts: infer-a3 showing 'panic: token-cache eviction index out of range'.

carlos: tracing sampling is low under pressure; agent shows TCP backlog hits on tracer dgram. That explains missing spans between gateway and runtime.

meera: immediate actions I can take: 1) apply temporary edge timeout = 60s for generate route, 2) enable gateway circuit-breaker to mark hosts with >5 502s in 1m as unhealthy, 3) trigger emergency GPU quota bump in us-west-2 (subject to cloud approval). Which do we want?

devon: apply 1 and 2 now, kick off 3 in parallel. Also notify customers to avoid >4k prompts until we stabilize. I'll draft status note.

sre-bot: ACTION: feature_flag set edge:timeout=60s for /v1/generate by meera at 02:21 PDT. Circuit-breaker rule deployed by carlos at 02:22 PDT.

nina: after mitigation: 5xx dropped from 1.6% -> 0.6% in 6m but still above SLO of 0.5%. Queue metrics: edge_queue_length peaked 310 -> now 45. Runtime infer-a3 still logs occasional panics.

carlos: started a canary debug pod for infer-a3 with additional debug symbols. Attached GDB; reproducing with synthetic test shows token-cache eviction race when concurrent KV cache evictions happen during high-concurrency decode. Stacktrace logged to S3 at s3://redwood-debug/infer-a3/stack_0212.log

meera: added temporary routing rule to avoid infer-a3 until we patch. Also adjusted tracing agent UDP buffer to reduce dropped spans. That made trace continuity better in recent samples.

devon: customers reported improvements. One reported the SDK still sees sporadic 502s when using older SDK version (no idempotency propagation on reconnect). We should add guidance to support for SDKs.

sre-bot: METRIC UPDATE: 5xx at 0.38% now. SLO no longer burning as of 02:46 PDT.

nina: root cause summary (prelim): scheduling delays + quota shortage -> queue pressure -> KV cache eviction race in runtime under load -> runtime panics which close connections -> gateway returns 502/504 and sometimes retries cause duplicate charge path due to lost idempotency headers on reconnect.

carlos: follow-ups: 1) runtime patch to fix cache eviction race (GH #4821 assigned to eng-runtime), 2) improve autoscaler headroom + quota planning for us-west-2 (meera), 3) gateway: preserve Idempotency-Key on reconnects and ensure billing guardrails (devon + infra), 4) tracing: raise tracer buffer under high QPS and trigger span retention when queue_length>200 (nina).

meera: opening emergency quota ticket with cloud provider and drafting autoscaler policy change: keep 25% spare GPU capacity in peak windows.

devon: I'll coordinate SDK advisory and billing investigation for any overcharge cases; also add integration test that simulates long prompts + reconnect to verify idempotency.

nina: creating post-incident slack summary and linking the saved dashboards and log queries: 
- Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/ops/timeout-5xx
- Datadog logs query: `service:inference AND env:prod AND route:/v1/generate AND status:[500 TO 599]`
- Saved trace view: https://traces.redwood/internal/view/5xx-2026-04-05

sre-bot: RESOLVED - mitigations effective at 02:46 PDT. Incident closed for now; engineering to follow up on fixes.

support-bot: participants: nina, carlos, meera, devon, sre-bot
